:::{#exm-matrix-analysis}
#### Eigenvalues of a small matrix

The matrix $\matr{A} = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 \end{bmatrix}$ has the eigenvalues
```{r}
#| echo: false
eigen(matrix(c(2, 1, 1, 2), nrow = 2))$values
```
Finding these eigenvalues is a question about the matrix $\matr{A}$ alone, so it is a topic of matrix analysis.
<!-- no-figure: the example is two numbers -->

:::
